I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the settled figure for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats.

Ilse first posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could already see that correction, and my reply points her to it.

The gbrain search was refused because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. I got the answer by reading only channels Dana belongs to.
